research.title: Livestock and enteric methane
research.note: The definitive real-world figures behind Herd's core mechanic; agriculture's share of methane emissions and where it comes from.

research.title: Accelerating climate solutions in agriculture
research.note: Documents a real ~42% methane-intensity reduction from better farm practices; directly supports Herd's decoupling hope angle.

research.title: Agriculture and Aquaculture: Food for Thought
research.note: Explains why methane's short-lived-but-potent warming profile makes it a distinct lever from CO2.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
